as_told.title: Early Vinod channeling of the Nine in 1952

related.note: Both describe the first channeling of the Nine at Puharich's group in Maine in 1952. This telling puts it at Dr. Vinod's unexpected trance on his first night, while the story puts it at a séance of nine people on New Year's Eve 1952-53.

plain: In 1952 an Indian visitor known as Dr. Vinod is said to have arrived at the Round Table Foundation, a research group in Maine, and on his very first night there fallen into a trance without warning and begun speaking for the Nine, a group of beings that the episode calls an alien council. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels this as "the story goes," pointing to tape recordings made by the Round Table and transcripts of the Nine sessions. Elsewhere on the show he speaks more generally of Vinod's early channeling all dating from 1952, citing the journals of Andrija Puharich, a man connected to the Round Table, without singling out the first night.
